query: NYS Prohibited Plants list New York State Department of Environmental Conservation prohibited plants
information:
The NYS Prohibited & Regulated Invasive Plants list (DEC, Nov 20 2020) identifies the following plant species as *prohibited*.  The list is organized by growth habit/category.  Only the *prohibited* species are included below—those that are also labeled “regulated” have not been listed because they are legal to possess and sell.  For each species both the common and scientific names are given (when both are provided in the document).  The information comes directly from the PDF “isprohibitedplants2.pdf” (NYS DEC, September 10 2014/November 20 2020).
